H4900.def: a primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.):--draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, × give, handle, make (pro-, sound)long, × sow, scatter, stretch out.

H4901.def: from «04900»; a sowing; also a possession:--precious, price.

H4902.et: the same in form as (04901), but probably of foreign derivation
H4902.def: the same in form as «04901», but probably of foreign derivation; Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him:--Mesech, Meshech.

H4904.def: from «07901»; a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse:--bed((-chamber)), couch, lieth (lying) with.

H4905.def: from «07919»; instructive, i.e. a didactic poem:--Maschil.

H4906.def: from the same as «07906»; a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively, imagination:--conceit, image(-ry), picture, × wish.

H4908.def: from «07931»; a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls):--dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.

H4909.def: from «07936»; wages or a reward:--reward, wages.

H4910.def: a primitive root; to rule:--(have, make to have) dominion, governor, × indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule(-ing, -r), have power.

H4911.def: denominative from «04912»; to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble:--be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4912.et: apparently from (04910) in some original sense of superiority in mental action
H4912.def: apparently from «04910» in some original sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse):--byword, like, parable, proverb.

H4913.def: for «04861»; Mashal, a place in Palestine:--Mashal.

H4915.def: («01») from «04910»; empire; («02») from «04911»; a parallel:--dominion, like.

H4916.def: or mishloach {mish-lo'-akh}; also mishlach {mish-lawkh'}; from «07971»; a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged:--to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.

H4917.def: feminine of «04916»; a mission, i.e. (abstractly) and favorable) release, or (concretely and unfavorable) an army:--discharge, sending.

H4918.def: from «07999»; allied; Meshullam, the name of seventeen Israelites:--Meshullam.

H4919.def: plural from «07999»; reconciliations:--Meshillemoth, an Israelite:--Meshillemoth. Compare «04921».

H4920.def: or Mshelemyahuw {mesh-eh-lem-yaw'-hoo}; from «07999» and «03050»; ally of Jah; Meshelemjah, an Israelite:--Meshelemiah.

H4921.def: from «07999»; reconciliation; Meshillemith, an Israelite:--Meshillemith. Compare «04919».

H4923.def: from «08074»; a waste or amazement:--astonishment, desolate.

H4924.def: from «08080»; fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man:--fat (one, -ness, -test, -test place).

H4927.def: the same as «04926»; Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite:--Mishma.

H4928.def: feminineal sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as a adae, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4929.def: from «08104»; a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (fig.); also (as observed) a usage (abstr.), or an example (concr.):--diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch.

H4931.def: fem. of «04929»; watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concr.) the sentry, the post; obj. preservation, or (concr.) safe; fig. observance, i.e. (abstr.) duty or (obj.) a usage or party:--charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch.

H4932.def: from «08138»; properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location):--college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

H4934.def: from the same as «08168»; a hollow, i.e. a narrow passage:--path.

H4936.def: apparently from «08159»; inspection; Misham, an Israelite:--Misham.

H4937.def: or mishtan {mish-awn'}; from «08172»; a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance:--stay.

H4938.def: or mishteneth {mish-eh'-neth}; feminine of «04937»; support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick:--staff.

H4940.def: from «08192» (compare «08198»); a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extens. a tribe or people:--family, kind(-red).

H4941.def: from «08199»; properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style:--+ adversary, ceremony, charge, × crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, × worthy, + wrong.

H4942.def: from «08192»; a stall for cattle (only dual):--burden, sheepfold.

H4943.et: from an unused root meaning to hold
H4943.def: from an unused root meaning to hold; possession:--+ steward.

H4944.def: from «08264»; a traversing, i.e. rapid motion:--running to and fro.

H4945.def: from «08248»; properly, causing to drink, i.e. a butler; by implication (intransitively), drink (itself); figuratively, a well-watered region:--butler(-ship), cupbearer, drink(-ing), fat pasture, watered.

H4947.et: from (08259) in its original sense of overhanging
H4947.def: from «08259» in its original sense of overhanging; a lintel:--lintel.

H4948.def: from «08254»; weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act):--(full) weight.

H4949.def: or mishqoleth {mish-ko'-leth}; feminine of «04948» or «04947»; a weight, i.e. a plummet (with line attached):--plummet.

H4950.def: from «08257»; a settling place (of water), i.e. a pond:--deep.

H4952.et: from (08281) in the sense of loosening
H4952.def: from «08281» in the sense of loosening; maceration, i.e. steeped juice:--liquor.

H4953.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «08319»; a (musical) pipe (from its whistling sound):--flute.

H4954.et: patrial from an unused noun from an unused root
H4954.def: patrial from an unused noun from an unused root; probably meaning to stretch out; extension; a Mishraite, or inhabitant (collectively) of Mishra:--Mishraites.

H4955.def: from «08313»; combustion, i.e. cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime):--burning.

H4956.def: from the plural of «04955» and «04325»; burnings of water; Misrephoth-Majim, a place in Palestine:--Misrephoth-mayim.

H4957.def: a form for «07796» used denominatively; vineyard; Masrekah, a place in Idumaea:--Masrekah.

H4958.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, i.e. hollow out
H4958.def: apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, i.e. hollow out; a pan:--pan.

H4959.def: a primitive root; to feel of; by implication, to grope:--feel, grope, search.

H4960.def: from «08354»; drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast:--banquet, drank, drink, feast((-ed), -ing).

H4962.def: from the same as «04970»; properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural):--+ few, × friends, men, persons, × small.

H4963.def: denominative from «08401»; straw in the heap:--straw.

H4964.et: from an unused root meaning to curb
H4964.def: from an unused root meaning to curb; a bit:--bit, bridle.

H4965.et: from (04964) and (0520) with the art. interposed
H4965.def: from «04964» and «0520» with the art. interposed; bit of the metropolis; Metheg-ha-Ammah, an epithet of Gath:--Metheg-ammah.

H4967.et: from (04962) and (0410), with the relative interposed
H4967.def: from «04962» and «0410», with the relative interposed; man who (is) of God; Methusael, an antediluvian patriarch:--Methusael.

H4968.def: from «04962» and «07973»; man of a dart; Methushelach, an antediluvian patriarch:--Methuselah.

H4969.def: a primitive root; to stretch out:--spread out.

H4970.et: from an unused root meaning to extend
H4970.def: from an unused root meaning to extend; properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative):--long, when.

H4971.et: from (08505) in the transferred sense of measuring
H4971.def: or mathkuneth {math-koo'-neth}; from «08505» in the transferred sense of measuring; proportion (in size, number or ingredients):--composition, measure, state, tale.

H4972.def: from «04100» and «08513»; what a trouble!:--what a weariness.

H4973.def: contr. from «03216»; properly, a biter, i.e. a tooth:--cheek (jaw) tooth, jaw.

H4974.def: from «08552»; wholesomeness; also (adverb) completely:--men (by reading «04962»), soundness.

H4975.et: from an unused root meaning to be slender
H4975.def: from an unused root meaning to be slender; properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins:--+ greyhound, loins, side.

H4976.def: from «05414»; a present:--gift, to give, reward.

H4977.def: the same as «04976»; Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite:--Mattan.

H4979.def: feminine of «04976»; a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe:--gift.

H4980.def: the same as «04979»; Mattanah, a place in the Desert:--Mattanah.

H4981.et: probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness
H4981.def: probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen:--Mithnite.

H4982.def: from «04976»; liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites:--Mattenai.

H4983.def: or Mattanyahuw {mat-tan-yaw'-hoo}; from «04976» and «03050»; gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites:--Mattaniah.

H4985.def: a primitive root; to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet:--be (made, × take) sweet.

H4988.def: from «04985»; a dainty, i.e. (generally) food:--feed sweetly.

H4989.def: feminine of «04987»; sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert:--Mithcah.

H4990.def: of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians:--Mithredath.

H4991.def: feminine of «04976» abbreviated form; a present:--gift.

H4992.def: for «04993»; gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite:--Mattathah.

H4993.def: or Mattithyahuw {mat-tith-yaw'-hoo}; from «04991» and «03050»; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites:-- Mattithiah.

H4994.et: a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered: "I pray," "now," or "then"
H4994.def: a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered: "I pray," "now," or "then"; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction:--I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

H4995.et: apparently from (05106) in the sense of harshness from refusal
H4995.def: apparently from «05106» in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly, tough, i.e. uncooked (flesh):--raw.

H4996.def: of Egyptian origin; No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt:--No. Compare «0528».

H4997.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification
H4997.def: or noywd {node}; also (feminine) no)dah {no-daw'}; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids):--bottle.

H4998.def: a primitive root; properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful:--be beautiful, become, be comely.

H4999.def: from «04998»; a home; figuratively, a pasture:--habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place.
